aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets around 4% per month, aiming for stretched growth. It involves higher concentration and potential for increased leverage, which amplifies both upside and drawdown. Be aware that leveraged ETFs decay daily, and this mode can lead to significant losses quickly if stops are not strictly adhered to.
